_comment: Shadbala worked example (BPHS Ch 27 method). Values transcribed from page images of the scan, not from OCR and not from memory. Page numbers are the book's printed page numbers.

source.title: Graha and Bhava Balas
source.author: B. V. Raman
source.edition: Second edition, Raman Publications, Bangalore, 1942 (preface to 2nd ed. dated 2 September 1942)
source.chart: The 'Standard Horoscope' of Raman's A Manual of Hindu Astrology, worked through Examples 3-56 (pp. 11-81)
source.why_not_santhanam: R. Santhanam, Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra Vol. 1 (Ranjan, 1992 printing; archive.org heag_brihat-parasara-hora-sastra-vol-1-...) Ch 27 pp. 264-288 has no complete worked chart, only fragments (Sun uchcha bala p. 265; ahargana lords for 1 June 1984 pp. 271-272).

longitudes_dm._page: p. 2 (Mars is printed 299 49 there, a misprint: pp. 12, 29, 71 and 75 all use 229 49)

inputs._apparent_time_page: p. 33 (2 p.m. LMT + 14 min equation of time = 2-14 p.m. L.A.T.)
inputs._ghati_page: p. 2 (birth 20-15 ghatis after sunrise; p. 37 prints 20-35 and p. 48 prints 20-16, all in the third part of the day)
inputs._ahargana_page: p. 43 (Example 23; Raman's condensed ahargana, counted from Wednesday)

seeghrochcha._page: pp. 69-71 (Venus 158.35 per Example 48 and Example 49; the Art. 104 list misprints 151.35)

cheshta._page: p. 72; p. 81 leaves Sun and Moon blank (no Chesta Bala, p. 92 Art. 136)

drik._page: pp. 80-81 (p. 80 prints Mars 5.53; p. 81 and its pinda +21.4 give 5.35)

errata_noted: p. 2: Mars printed 299 49; every computation uses 229 49.
p. 22: Moon's Hora column prints 30.000, but p. 18 gives Sama (7.5) and the Moon's printed total 48.750 only adds up with 7.5.
p. 25 text: female planets get Drekkana bala in the last drekkana; the p. 26 table (Moon, second drekkana, 15.0) follows BPHS: male first, female second, neuter third.
p. 75: Mars-to-Saturn aspect angle printed 225 2; 124 51 - 229 49 = 255 2, which gives the printed -22.5.
p. 79: Sun's row prints Jupiter +42.5 and Saturn -11.6 (rules give 42.2 and 12.1) and Moon's row prints Mars -36.2 (rules give 36.9); the printed pinda totals differ from their own rows.

p. 22: Mars's Trimsamsa column prints Swa (30). Mars at 229 49 (Vrischika 19 49) falls in Jupiter's trimsamsa, Sama per p. 17 (7.5); Swa is the trimsamsa of the p. 2 misprint 299 49. Saptavargaja, sthana and total are 22.5 virupas too high.

p. 22: Saturn's Saptamsa column prints Sama (7.5). Saturn at Simha 4 51 is past the first saptamsa (4 17), so its saptamsa lord is Mercury, Adhi Mitra per p. 17 (22.5). Saptavargaja, sthana and total are 15 virupas too low.
p. 55: Venus's Ayana bala prints 23.80; (24 - 4.56) / 48 x 60 = 24.30.
p. 81: Mercury's rupas print 9.743; the printed 580.460 virupas are 9.674 rupas.
